sources.snippet: ViPragSent ViPragSent is a Vietnamese social-media benchmark and reproducibility package for pragmatic sentiment phenomena: implicit sentiment, sarcasm, irony, idiomatic or figurative language, code-switching, and mocking. The project also records intended polarity and emotion as auxiliary tasks.
